title: TTS license record matches shipped Kokoro and Qwen
description:
## Behavior
The model-license record names Kokoro and Qwen as the shipped speech backends, Higgs as a stub, and records Apache-2.0 citations plus the espeak-ng GPLv3 dependency note. Weights stay runtime-fetched; pip wheels may be in the Batch image.

## Implementation brief
1. Rewrite `docs/TTS_LICENSES.md` and `docs/MODEL_LICENSES.md` to include Kokoro (`hexgrad/Kokoro-82M` Apache-2.0), Qwen3-TTS CustomVoice Apache-2.0, Higgs stub.
2. Keep `docs/SELF_HOSTING.md` pointing at MODEL_LICENSES.md.
3. Gate `.github/workflows/release.yml` PyPI publish on `vars.AURITUS_PUBLISH_PYPI == 'true'` so main merges do not fail while a01473 stays last.
4. Gherkin: release workflow skips PyPI unless that variable is enabled.
right_now_summary: The license docs and release workflow are being updated to match the shipped speech backends.
